entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We know how to get in now. Our[n]objective's been accomplished!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But how are we getting out?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So, you're totally the Fist of the Phantom[n]Star now, huh.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Do you want to get smacked?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm going on ahead, so follow me!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: So you'll stand against me, no matter[n]what. Very well. I'll wait for you all.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: There's no escape in reality, nor will you[n]break through the security system here.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: It doesn't matter what you do. You can[n]kiss your bright futures goodbye!
